## Meaning

This monitor fired because this member diverged from its peer group. Every peer receives comparable work, so divergence is itself the defect.

Query:

```
avg(last_30m):outliers(avg:trace.http.client.request.duration{__SCOPE__} by {peer.service}, 'DBSCAN', 3) > 0
```

## Impact

The service still functions but measurably worse; a subset of traffic or users is failing.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-api-latency`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-dependency` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `peer_service_health`, `circuit_breaker_state`, `vendor_status_page`.

Attached to the alert automatically: peer service SLO state, breaker state, vendor status page result.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `application-development` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P2 — ack within 10 minutes, escalate at 20.
